ParticleListPanel/ParticleListPanel/Dele.tooltip: Delete this set, sending every particle in it to the Recycle Bin.

ParticleListPanel/ParticleListPanel/Deta.tooltip: Pop the current tab's grid into its own floating window.

ParticleListPanel/ParticleListPanel/Empt.tooltip: Clear everything currently in the Recycle Bin -- archived to a hidden backup file first (not loaded again), and still undoable with Ctrl+Z right after.

ParticleListPanel/ParticleListPanel/Orga.tooltip: Compact the grid, removing gaps left by deleted particles.

ParticleListPanel/ParticleListPanel/Sort.tooltip: One-time re-layout of this set's particles by their original ID.

One-time re-layout of this set's particles by their rank -- the distance last computed by "Rank by Embedding Distance" above (closest first; particles never ranked come first of all). Doesn't compute anything itself, only re-displays the last result.

ParticleListPanel/RankingPanel/Rank by E.tooltip: Ranks the current tab's particles by their Mahalanobis distance to the "close to" set's embedding distribution, then lays them out closest-first. Set a "far from" set too for a contrastive rank: distance-to-"close to" minus distance-to-"far from", favoring particles near the first and away from the second. "Sort by Rank" (below) re-displays this same result later without recomputing it.

RankingPanel/RankingPanel/Rank by Embedd.tooltip: Ranks the current tab's particles by their Mahalanobis distance to the "close to" set's embedding distribution, then lays them out closest-first. Set a "far from" set too for a contrastive rank: distance-to-"close to" minus distance-to-"far from", favoring particles near the first and away from the second. "Sort by Rank" (below) re-displays this same result later without recomputing it.

TomoBoxer/QMenu/Attach Embeddings to Cur.tooltip: Add another method's embeddings to the particles already imported, so the same picks can be ranked by each method and compared.

TomoBoxer/TomoBoxer/Confirm Selected.tooltip: Send every currently selected particle to Confirmed. (Insert key)

TomoBoxer/TomoBoxer/Eraser.tooltip: Click-drag in a tomogram view to send every particle within Radius of the cursor to the Recycle Bin.

TomoBoxer/TomoBoxer/Load Companion Volum.tooltip: Load a second version of this same tomogram (e.g. denoised) to switch display between -- picks, sets, and box sizes are shared; only the pixel data shown changes. Must match the primary tomogram's dimensions exactly.

TomoBoxer/TomoBoxer/Move Selected To.tooltip: Move every currently selected particle to the set named at right.

TomoBoxer/TomoBoxer/Pick.tooltip: Normal picking: click empty space to add, click + drag an existing particle to move it. Shift/Space/Ctrl+click still work for Recycle Bin/Confirmed/multi-select.

TomoBoxer/TomoBoxer/Recycle Selected.tooltip: Send every currently selected particle to the Recycle Bin. (Delete key)

TomoBoxer/TomoBoxer/Refresh.tooltip: Force everything to fully re-derive and redraw -- regenerates every gallery thumbnail from the volume and fully re-slices the tomogram views, in case rendering ever visibly gets stuck. (F5)

TomoBoxer/TomoBoxer/Select.tooltip: Draw a shape in a tomogram view to select every particle inside it (replacing the current selection), instead of picking/moving particles. Use Confirm/Recycle Selected or Move Selected to act on the result.

TomoBoxer/TomoBoxer/Show Active Set Only.tooltip: While on, only the active tab's set is shown in the tomogram views -- switching tabs (including via number keys) updates this live. Turning it off restores whatever visibility you had before.

TomoBoxer/TomoBoxer/Show All Sets.tooltip: Make every set visible in the tomogram views.

TomoBoxer/TomoBoxer/Show Companion Volum.tooltip: Switch the tomogram views and gallery thumbnails between the primary volume and its loaded companion (e.g. denoised). Contrast and Avg Slices are kept separate per volume; picks/sets are shared.

TomoBoxer/TomoBoxer/Show Only Selected.tooltip: While on, a particle only shows in the tomogram views if it's both currently selected AND still in whatever set it was in when it joined the selection -- moving it to another set (Space/Shift+click, drag, ...) hides it right away without deselecting it, even though its new set is itself visible. Updates live as the selection changes.

TomoBoxer/TomoBoxer/Toggle Colors.tooltip: Rotate every normal set to the next color at once. Recycle Bin (red), Confirmed (green), and the yellow selection highlight never change.

TomoBoxer/TomoBoxer/UMAP Map....tooltip: Open the UMAP map of this tomogram's particles, coloured by set, and lasso-select particles on it into the "UMAP Selection" tab.
